concerns.location: spec.md:Requirements / Success Criteria (absence of generalization check)
concerns.text: The idea's methodology sketch explicitly includes a 'Generalization Check: Verify robustness by testing the adapter on synthetic variations of the navigation graphs (e.g., modified screen resolutions or widget ordering)'. The spec only mentions invariance as an unverified Assumption ('structural features are invariant to minor layout shifts') — there is no FR or SC requiring the adapter to be evaluated on synthetic navigation-graph variations. This drops a required piece of the idea's methodology.
